d:
From India’s rapid election counting to America’s days-long vote tally, how do the two democracies manage elections so differently? Meanwhile, record gold prices, weak monsoons and household budget pressures have pushed India’s gold demand to a six-year low, even as unofficial imports surged over 1,500%. Hem Saroya explores the contrasting election systems and the growing paradox in India’s gold market, including the rise in gold smuggling and its impact on organised jewellers.
Firstpost | Hem Saroya | Vantage
